compress_messages: compress a list of conversation messages into a shorter sequence that fits within the token budget
should_compress_check: check whether the conversation context has exceeded the compression threshold
update_token_usage: update tracked token usage from an LLM API response dict
get_engine_status: get a status dict with token usage, context length, and compression count
handle_engine_tool_call: handle a tool call from the context engine and return a JSON string result
